description.en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.

description.zh: 一块或多块云盘的ID。取值是JSON数组格式，云盘ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: A JSON array of one or more disk IDs.

description.zh: 自动快照策略和云盘所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region where the automatic snapshot policy and target disks are located. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to get the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

title.zh: 为云盘应用自动快照策略

descriptions.zh:
- 每块云盘支持应用多条自动快照策略，最多 10 条。
- 若目标云盘已应用自动快照策略，在调用该接口时，将在原有基础上新增，不会更换已有策略。
>请自主取消不需要的自动快照策略，以免产生非预期费用。
descriptions.en:
- Each disk supports up to 10 automatic snapshot policies.

- If a target disk already has an automatic snapshot policy, this operation adds the new policy without replacing the existing ones.

> To avoid unexpected charges, make sure to cancel any automatic snapshot policies that you no longer need.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs apply-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp14yziiuvu3s6jn0000 --disk-ids d-bp14k9cxvr5uzy540000_,_d-bp1dtj8v7x6u08iw0000_,_d-bp1c0tyj9tfli2r80000 --region cn-hangzhou
